summary_1line: Vasishtha extols the sacredness of cows, prescribing mantras and gifts of kine that grant heavenly rewards and purify sins.

image_candidates.scene_text: A devotee stands amid a large herd of cows at dawn, hands raised in prayer while reciting mantras to the sacred animals.
Celestial realms appear with rivers of milk and golden palaces as souls who gifted thousands of cows arrive among Gandharvas and Apsaras.
King Saudasa ceremonially presents richly adorned cows with calves and brass milking vessels to gathered Brahmanas.
